summary: This is open versus enclosed. The Neakasa M1 Plus has an open top that cats tend to accept quickly, takes cats up to 33 lb, holds 11.2 L of waste, needs no carbon filter, and costs $150 less. The PetSnowy SNOW+ is fully enclosed, seals waste into a liner after every cycle, and is built around odour. If your cat has refused a hooded box before, the Neakasa is the safer bet. If smell in a small space is what you are fighting, the PetSnowy contains it better. Both lock you into their own bags.
chooseA: Your cat avoids enclosed or hooded boxes
You have a large breed — it is rated up to 33 lb
You want to skip carbon filters entirely
You want to spend $150 less and get a 2-year protection plan
chooseB: Odour containment matters more than easy entry
The box will live in a small or poorly ventilated room
You want waste sealed into a liner after each cycle
An enclosed design suits your space and your cat
